classification: retrospective literature-informed two-window market-structure replication on reused historical calendars; not fresh, blind, prospective, academically novel, predictive alpha, a return strategy, or a deployment claim

hypothesis.causal_story: Human and institution-linked trading schedules, staffed risk desks, and business-week capital flows concentrate participation on Monday-Friday even though crypto trades continuously. Within a complete Monday-Sunday UTC week, weekday minutes should therefore have more trades and more quote notional than the same full set of minute-of-day slots on Saturday-Sunday.
hypothesis.primary_claim: On Binance BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT USD-M perpetuals, complete UTC weekdays exhibit a persistent participation premium over weekends in both one-minute trade arrivals and quote volume.
hypothesis.checkable_edge: In both frozen half-year windows, the pooled median weekday/weekend trade-count ratio is at least 1.15, each asset's median is at least 1.10, the pooled median quote-volume ratio is at least 1.15, both asset-specific quote-volume ratios are positive, at least 80% of included Monday-month groups are positive for both endpoints, and both paired week-block bootstrap p-values are below cycle alpha 0.008333333333333333.
hypothesis.source_context: Petukhina, Reule, and Hardle, Rise of the Machines? Intraday High-Frequency Trading Patterns of Cryptocurrencies, arXiv:2009.04200, documents temporal trading patterns and motivates a human-schedule interpretation. This contract is a narrower local day-of-week replication; it does not test directional returns or claim independent discovery.

loop_multiplicity.interpretation: Both endpoints, both assets, stability, primary, and replication are conjunctive requirements. Failure of any one closes the mechanism. Ordinal k=2 and its alpha are spent even on missing data or integrity failure.
loop_multiplicity.familywise_scope: The 0.05 budget covers only cycles minted under frontier-loop-policy.json after its effective time, not earlier 2026-09-01 campaigns.

assets_and_data.integrity: Before candidate parsing, re-verify the contract, audit, loop-policy, and inventory hashes plus every listed archive hash, byte size, sidecar-file hash, sidecar-declared archive hash/name, single member, exact header, and CRC. Any mismatch aborts and writes no result artifact.
assets_and_data.validation: Normalize open_time as microseconds divided by 1000 iff the raw integer is greater than 100000000000000, otherwise milliseconds. Require unique exact UTC-minute timestamps, finite nonnegative quote_asset_volume, and nonnegative integer number_of_trades. A missing minute or any zero trade count or zero quote volume rejects that asset-week and is counted; malformed schema aborts the invocation without an artifact.
assets_and_data.lawfulness: Keyless Binance Data Vision public archives, internal research only; raw redistribution remains subject to Binance terms recorded in quant-trading/data/manifest.json source_policies.binance.

frozen_rule.week: A week is Monday 00:00:00 UTC through the following Monday exclusive. Include only weeks fully contained in the requested window. The primary has 26 complete weeks. The replication has 26 complete weeks; 2024-12-30 and 2024-12-31 are boundary days outside any complete included week.
frozen_rule.groups: Weekday W contains all 7,200 one-minute bars from Monday-Friday. Weekend E contains all 2,880 one-minute bars from Saturday-Sunday. Because each category contains every minute-of-day equally often within a complete week, arithmetic category means are minute-of-day matched. No hour, holiday, event, or volatility filter is permitted.
frozen_rule.weekly_observation: For each asset-week, require all 10,080 unique minute bars. w_count/e_count are arithmetic means of number_of_trades over W/E; w_quote/e_quote are arithmetic means of quote_asset_volume over W/E. x_count = log(w_count/e_count); x_quote = log(w_quote/e_quote). All four components must be positive. No winsorization, weighting, transform variant, alternative weekend definition, or subset selection.
frozen_rule.sampling: One paired observation per asset per complete week. Only weeks complete for both BTC and ETH enter pooled, per-asset, month-stability, or bootstrap statistics; both assets move together in every resample.
frozen_rule.statistics: Report pooled and per-asset medians of x_count and x_quote. Assign each week to the calendar month containing its Monday. An included Monday-month contains at least one complete paired week; stability is the fraction of included Monday-months whose pooled median is strictly positive.
frozen_rule.bootstrap: 20,000 circular moving-block resamples of sorted complete week starts using Python standard-library random.Random (MT19937), seed 20260902, block length 2 weeks, randrange(n_weeks) starts, whole circular blocks truncated to exactly n_weeks, and both assets kept paired. Each endpoint starts a fresh generator at the same seed and therefore receives identical week draws. For endpoint e, p_e = (1 + count(pooled_median_e_boot <= 0)) / 20001.

declared_power_limit: The independent unit is a UTC week, not 10,080 minute bars or two correlated assets. At least 24 weeks gives roughly 12 two-week dependence blocks per window. This design targets a persistent 15% activity gap; it can miss smaller, seasonal, venue-specific, day-specific, or intraday-only effects. A failure falsifies only this coarse two-asset weekday/weekend contrast. A pass establishes a replicated participation regularity consistent with human/institutional scheduling, not its cause.

gates.G2_count_asset_consistency: BTCUSDT median x_count >= log(1.10) AND ETHUSDT median x_count >= log(1.10)
gates.G4_quote_asset_consistency: BTCUSDT median x_quote > 0 AND ETHUSDT median x_quote > 0
gates.G5_month_stability: For both x_count and x_quote, at least 80% of included Monday-month groups have strictly positive pooled medians
gates.G6_dependence_robustness: p_count < 0.008333333333333333 AND p_quote < 0.008333333333333333 under the frozen paired week-block bootstrap
gates.pass_rule: A window passes only if its minimum sample is met and G1 through G6 are all true; all gates are conjunctive.
gates.fail_rule: If minimum sample is met and any gate is false, the mechanism is falsified on that window.
gates.inconclusive_rule: Only frozen missing/zero-bar rejections reducing the paired sample below minimum yield an inconclusive result. Contract, audit, policy, inventory, checksum, CRC, member, header, or schema failures abort without an artifact. UNKNOWN never passes.

stopping_and_replication.campaign_mint: After independent read-only approval, mint exactly one campaign with scripts/campaign.py init and this file's final SHA-256.
stopping_and_replication.primary_run: Exactly one outcome-producing primary execution after campaign mint.
stopping_and_replication.on_primary_fail: Write and publish negative evidence, close FROZEN-NEGATIVE, never run replication, and never tune, pool, extend, redefine weekends, or re-window this mechanism.
stopping_and_replication.on_primary_inconclusive: Write evidence, close FROZEN-INCONCLUSIVE, spend cycle ordinal 2, and do not reinterpret missingness.
stopping_and_replication.on_primary_pass: Commit the write-once primary artifact, then run the already frozen replication exactly once with identical contract, code hash, formulas, thresholds, seed, and alpha.
stopping_and_replication.survival_rule: Survival requires both primary and replication to meet minimum sample and pass G1-G6. Then close FROZEN-CERTIFIED. Replication failure closes FROZEN-NEGATIVE; replication sample failure closes FROZEN-INCONCLUSIVE.
stopping_and_replication.write_once: The runner refuses an existing output path. Replication requires --primary-artifact and its SHA-256; it refuses unless role, pass status, contract, runner, audit, policy, and inventory hashes all match.

multiplicity_boundary.interpretation: Trade count, quote volume, both assets, magnitude, stability, bootstrap evidence, primary, and replication are an intersection-union claim: all must pass. No individual weekdays, hours, holidays, other assets, alternative weekends, return analyses, or post-outcome thresholds are permitted.

claim_boundary: A two-window pass supports only a replicated Binance BTC/ETH one-minute weekday participation regularity consistent with human/institutional scheduling. Familywise-error language is scoped only to post-policy cycles. It does not prove causality and does not establish directional predictability, executable alpha, net return, implementation advantage, deployment readiness, capital allocation, or an absolute breakthrough.
